Provalus is actively hiring entry-level Healthcare Insurance Customer Support Representatives to support claims processing, member inquiries, and customer service activities for health insurance products. Responsibilities include: 

  • Learn and apply claims processing procedures, healthcare terminology, and company systems through structured, on-the-job training. 

  • Research claims status, benefits, eligibility, and coverage details using available resources, CRM, and internal claims processing systems. 

  • Handle and resolve member and provider inquiries related to claims processing, billing questions, coverage, and general customer service issues. 

  • Provide members and providers with clear, accurate information regarding plan benefits and claims status. 

  • Process claims-related forms and other member/provider requests accurately and within required timeframes. 

  • Identify and escalate priority or complex issues to senior team members or management as needed. 

  • Route inbound calls to the appropriate internal resources, including claims, billing, or clinical teams. 

  • Follow up on more complicated member calls as needed, with support from senior team members. 

  • Complete accurate call notes and claims documentation, updating records in the CRM and claims processing systems. 

  • Gather and record relevant details from member/provider interactions, including comments, inquiries, complaints, and actions taken. 

  • Maintain strict confidentiality of protected health information (PHI) and personally identifiable information (PII) in accordance with HIPAA and applicable regulations — full training provided.

  • Ask questions and seek guidance from trainers, mentors, and team leads as you build your skills. 

  • Other duties as assigned. 

Role Requirements include: 

  • Must have an HS Diploma or GED. 

  • No prior healthcare, insurance, or claims experience required — comprehensive training provided. 

  • Willingness to learn healthcare terminology, basic medical billing/coding concepts, and insurance claims processes. 

  • Ability to work onsite at the Provalus office. No remote positions are available currently. 

  • Excellent communication skills, including verbal and written communication. 

  • Ability to work well with others in a team environment. 

  • Good computer skills and comfort learning new software/systems; ability to multi-task. 

  • Willingness to learn and follow HIPAA and confidentiality requirements when handling sensitive information. 

  • Strong attention to detail and a willingness to double-check work for accuracy. 

  • Ability to stay calm, professional, and patient in stressful or fast-paced situations. 

  • Coachable and open to feedback, with a strong desire to grow within the healthcare insurance field.

  • Paid, structured on-the-job training — no experience necessary to get started. 

  • Clear path for career growth and advancement into more senior or leadership roles. 

  • Supportive team environment with ongoing coaching and mentorship.

job.title: Inside Sales Team Lead- Industry Telcomedia
job.description:
Position Summary
The Sales Supervisor is responsible for driving team performance by leading a group of Inbound Sales Representatives selling telecommunications products and services, including mobile (wireless), high-speed internet, and video/entertainment solutions. This role focuses on ensuring successful bundling to maximize customer value.
The Sales Supervisor operates in a high-volume, quota-driven environment and is accountable for achieving team sales targets, coaching and developing representatives, and building a high-performing sales culture. This role combines hands-on sales leadership, performance management, and talent development. The Sales Supervisor is also expected to spend a portion of their time actively selling to customers to maintain product expertise, reinforce sales best practices, and model expected behaviors for the team.

Responsibilities

  • Lead, motivate, and manage a team of Inside Sales Representatives to achieve and exceed monthly and quarterly sales targets
  • Monitor individual and team performance metrics including units sold, upgrades, conversion rates, and revenue attainment
  • Conduct regular performance reviews, one-on-one coaching sessions, and team meetings
  • Identify performance gaps and implement targeted coaching and improvement plans
  • Foster a high-energy, competitive, and customer-focused team environment
  • Support team members in handling complex customer interactions and objection handling
  • Analyze sales data and trends to optimize performance and improve results
  • Provide ongoing coaching on product knowledge, sales techniques, and customer engagement
  • Drive employee engagement, retention, and career development
  • Dedicate a portion of time to direct selling activities, including engaging with customers, closing sales, and supporting peak volume periods
  • Ensure accurate CRM usage and reporting of sales activities and customer interactions
  • Maintain compliance with company policies, procedures, and sales practices



Qualifications - Preferred
  • 3+ years of sales experience, with at least 1 year in a leadership, supervisory, or team lead role
  • Demonstrated ability to meet or exceed team sales quotas
  • Strong leadership, coaching, and team development skills
  • Excellent communication, interpersonal, and problem-solving abilities
  • Ability to perform effectively in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment
  • Basic computer proficiency and ability to navigate CRM systems


Compensation:
Compensation includes a base salary plus uncapped commission and/or team-based incentives. Earnings are tied to both individual contributions and team performance, including achievement of sales targets, revenue goals, and key performance metrics.

Work Environment
This role operates in an inside sales contact center environment based onsite. The position requires extended periods of sitting, frequent computer use, and handling a high volume of customer interactions. The Team Lead is expected to be highly visible and accessible to support their team throughout the day.

Performance Expectations
•Achievement of team monthly and quarterly sales quotas
•Strong performance in wireless product sales metrics
•Consistent conversion of leads to closed sales
•High level of customer satisfaction and professionalism
•Demonstrated improvement in individual rep performance through coaching
•Successful hiring, onboarding, and retention of top sales talent

  • Basic understanding of Windows and/or Mac operating systems, Microsoft Office, and common business applications.

  • Ability to troubleshoot methodically, follow documented procedures, and ask clarifying questions. 

  • Comfortable multitasking and navigating multiple systems and screens simultaneously. 

  • Reliable, coachable, and able to work effectively in a fast-paced environment.

  • CompTIA A+ or similar entry-level IT certification. 

  • Experience with ITSM/ticketing platforms (e.g., ServiceNow, Zendesk, Freshservice, Ivanti).

  • Prior experience in a call center, help desk, or technical support environment.

Provalus is seeking a Healthcare Insurance Customer Support Representative to support claims processing, member inquiries, and customer service activities for health insurance products.   • Excellent communication skills, including verbal and written communication, particularly when explaining complex claims or coverage information clearly. 

  • Ability to work effectively with others in a team environment. 

  • Good computer and multi-tasking skills, with the ability to navigate multiple systems (CRM, claims platforms) simultaneously. 

  • Competency in related computer applications. 

  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy, given the sensitivity of healthcare and claims data. 

  • Ability to react effectively and calmly in stressful situations, including when handling frustrated members or complex claims disputes.

Provalus, part of the OPS brand, is changing the landscape in the technology solutions industry with our innovative go-to-market strategies. Provalus hires and develops the best and brightest talent in rural America to deliver technology and support services for Fortune 1000 companies. 

At Provalus, we are uniquely “purpose-driven.” We’re elevating under-served communities by developing untapped talent in rural towns across the U.S. to deliver technology, business and support services to our clients. We are actively seeking a full-time Help Desk Analyst to join our growing organization and help further our mission. 

This role will be responsible for providing Tier 1 & 2 support as needed to resolve end-user issues. Help Desk activities will encompass resolution of issues related software, hardware, mobile, and other applications as needed. The right candidate will have 2+ years of Technical Support experience within a client-facing environment. 

Primary Responsibilities: 

  • Provides on-site Tier 1 & 2 support to end users on a variety of issues. 

  • Help desk support deliverables include: initial problem determination, clear and concise documentation, diagnostics and information capture, resolution, customer status updates, escalate ticket requests to appropriate team members. 

  • Perform technical diagnosis and troubleshooting for users with hardware, software, and connectivity issues. 

  • Diagnoses and troubleshoots end user desktop application issues and provides appropriate solution 

  • Responds to tickets escalated from Tier I as needed 

  • Successfully manage assigned ticket to closure utilizing ticketing system (ServiceNow) 

  • Follow-up with end-users to provide status updates per client guidelines (SLA's) 

Qualifications 

  • 2+ years in a technical support role doing desktop support or experience working on a help desk 

  • Ability to deliver outstanding technical service for both internal and external staff in-person or over the telephone. 

  • Must have the ability to work independently and ability to collaborate as a team. 

  • Experience working with Microsoft products and heavy familiarity working with Outlook and Office 365 a must 

  • Service Now or related ticketing system experience a MUST 

  • Must be a U.S. Citizen 
  • Must be fluent in both Spanish and English

THE JOB 

Provalus is actively hiring entry-level Dispatch Coordinators / Call Center Agents to support scheduling and coordination of field technician appointments for telecommunications and media services, including internet, video/entertainment, and home services installation and repair. No prior dispatch or telecom experience is required — full paid training is provided on dispatch systems, scheduling tools, and company processes. This is a great opportunity to start a career in the telecommunications industry, with accelerated career advancement opportunities for those who perform well. 

Responsibilities include: 

  • Learn and apply dispatch procedures, scheduling systems, and company processes through structured, on-the-job training. 

  • Answer inbound calls from customers and field technicians regarding service appointments, installations, and repairs. 

  • Schedule, confirm, and adjust field technician appointments based on customer availability, technician capacity, and service area coverage. 

  • Communicate with field technicians throughout the day to track job status, provide updates, and relay customer information. 

  • Monitor technician schedules and routes, identifying and helping resolve scheduling conflicts, delays, or gaps in coverage. 

  • Notify customers of appointment windows, technician arrival updates, delays, or rescheduling needs. 

  • Research required information using available resources, CRM, and dispatch/scheduling tools to resolve customer and technician inquiries. 

  • Identify and escalate priority issues (e.g., missed appointments, service outages, urgent repairs) to senior team members or management as needed. 

  • Route inbound calls to the appropriate internal resources when a request falls outside dispatch (e.g., billing, technical support, sales). 

  • Complete accurate call notes and dispatch records, updating information in the CRM and dispatch systems in real time. 

  • Record details of customer and technician interactions, including comments, inquiries, complaints, and actions taken. 

  • Communicate and coordinate with internal departments (e.g., field operations, technical support, customer service) to ensure smooth service delivery. 

  • Ask questions and seek guidance from trainers, mentors, and team leads as you build your skills. 

  • Other duties as assigned. 

 

Role Requirements include: 

  • Must have HS Diploma or GED. 

  • No prior dispatch, telecom, or call center experience required — comprehensive training provided. 

  • Willingness to learn dispatch software, scheduling systems, and telecom service/product basics. 

  • Ability to work onsite at the Provalus office. No remote positions are available at this time. 

  • Excellent communication skills, including verbal and written communication. 

  • Ability to work well with others in a team environment. 

  • Good computer skills and comfort learning new software/systems; ability to multi-task and manage multiple schedules or calls at once. 

  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, given the importance of accurate scheduling and routing. 

  • Ability to stay calm, professional, and patient in stressful or fast-paced situations, including when coordinating time-sensitive appointments. 

  • Coachable and open to feedback, with a strong desire to grow within the telecommunications field. 

  • Flexibility to work varying shifts, as dispatch coverage may extend beyond standard business hours depending on business needs. 

What We Offer: 

  • Paid, structured on-the-job training — no experience necessary to get started. 

  • Clear path for career growth and advancement into more senior or leadership roles. 

  • Supportive team environment with ongoing coaching and mentorship. 

Job Type: Full-time Work Location: In person
